title: OrderPaymentFailed
description: EventBridge `detail` for an order that failed to materialize or be paid for. Producer: milkful.order — a subscription delivery (MA-132, source=SUBSCRIPTION) or a cart checkout (MA-136, source=CHECKOUT). Consumers: Notification Service (future); Reporting.

subscriptionId.description: Set for SUBSCRIPTION; null/absent for CHECKOUT.

amountPaise.description: 0 for DELIVERY_ADDRESS_UNKNOWN/PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE — the order failed before a price was ever obtained. Strictly positive for INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE/WALLET_NOT_ACTIVE, which always have a real quoted amount.
